settings.title: Focused practices for
settings.intro: Three practices, one way of working: diagnose the facts, design the path, and drive delivery until the outcome holds.

design.title: Corporate strategy
design.text: Market position, portfolio choices, and the growth math behind them. We help you pick the bets worth making.

design.title: Commercial due diligence
design.text: Rigorous, independent assessment of a market, a competitor, or an acquisition target before you commit capital.

build.title: Operating-model design
build.text: Org structure, roles, and decision rights aligned to the strategy — so the org chart stops fighting the plan.

build.title: Cost & margin programs
build.text: Find the waste that's quietly eroding margin, protect what matters, and build durable cost discipline.

launch.title: M&A integration
launch.text: Two companies, one direction. We run the integration plan so the deal's value actually shows up on your P&L.

launch.title: Transformation office
launch.text: A standing program office that keeps multi-year change on track, on budget, and on message.

settings.title: A calm, evidence-based

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: We spend time in the business — on the floor, in the data, with the people closest to the problem — to define it precisely. No off-the-shelf answer.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: A pragmatic plan with options, trade-offs, and a clear recommendation. You decide; we give you the facts to decide well.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: We work alongside your teams, not around them, building capability as we go. Our people sit next to yours through execution.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: We measure against the KPIs you care about and stay through the first reporting cycle — because a plan that isn't measured is a guess.

settings.note: Most engagements run 8–16 weeks. You'll always know the scope, the team, and the price before we start.

settings.title: Before we start,
settings.intro: The questions leaders ask most often before engaging us.

items.question: How is Meridian & Co. different from a Big Four firm?
items.answer: You get senior partners doing the actual work, a smaller engaged team, and fees that reflect the scope — not a brand tax. We take fewer clients so we can commit to the ones we take.

items.question: Who actually does the work on my engagement?
items.answer: The partners who sell the engagement lead it, supported by a small senior team. We deliberately avoid the leverage model that staffs juniors on your problem.

items.question: How long does a typical engagement run?
items.answer: Most run 8–16 weeks, but every scope is set in writing before we start. You'll always know the timeline, the team, and the fee upfront.

items.question: What if we can't afford the full engagement?
items.answer: We scope down honestly. A focused diagnostic or a single-practice engagement often delivers most of the value at a fraction of the cost.
